Create a new warranty record for an asset or component.

**Request Body Variables:**
- userId: User ID ({{userId}}) - Required
- username: Username ({{username}}) - Required
- projectType: Project type ({{projectType}}) - Optional
- assetId: Asset ID ({{assetId}}) - Required
- componentId: Component ID ({{componentId}}) - Optional
- warrantyStatus: Warranty status ({{warrantyStatus}}) - Required
- warrantyProvider: Warranty provider name ({{warrantyProvider}}) - Optional
- warrantyTerms: Warranty terms description ({{warrantyTerms}}) - Optional
- startDate: Warranty start date ({{startDate}}) - Required, format: yyyy-MM-dd
- endDate: Warranty end date ({{endDate}}) - Required, format: yyyy-MM-dd
- documentId: Document ID for warranty document ({{documentId}}) - Optional
- docType: Document type ({{docType}}) - Optional

**Note:** Document uploads are handled separately via DocumentController.

Link an ASSET to a user. Supports universal entity linking for ASSET, COMPONENT, MODEL, MAKE, AMC, WARRANTY, DOCUMENT.

**Request Body Variables:**
- userId: Caller user ID ({{userId}})
- username: Caller username ({{username}})
- entityType: Entity type - ASSET, COMPONENT, MODEL, MAKE, AMC, WARRANTY, DOCUMENT
- entityId: ID of the entity to link (use {{assetId}}, {{componentId}}, etc.)
- targetUserId: Target user ID to link the entity to ({{targetUserId}})
- targetUsername: Target username ({{targetUsername}})

**Example Entity Types:**
- ASSET: Link an asset to a user
- COMPONENT: Link a component to a user
- MODEL: Link a model to a user
- MAKE: Link a make to a user
- AMC: Link an AMC to a user
- WARRANTY: Link a warranty to a user
- DOCUMENT: Link a document to a user

**Note:** All entity ID fields are optional. Provide only the IDs you want to link.

Link a user to multiple entities using the string format (backward compatible).

**Request Body Variables:**
- userId: Caller user ID ({{userId}})
- username: Caller username ({{username}})
- targetUserId: Target user ID ({{targetUserId}})
- targetUsername: Target username ({{targetUsername}})
- entityLinks: Array of strings in format "TYPE:ID" (e.g., ["ASSET:1", "COMPONENT:2"])

**String Format Examples:**
- "ASSET:1001" - Link asset with ID 1001
- "COMPONENT:501" - Link component with ID 501
- "MODEL:201" - Link model with ID 201
- "MAKE:101" - Link make with ID 101
- "AMC:301" - Link AMC with ID 301
- "WARRANTY:401" - Link warranty with ID 401
- "DOCUMENT:701" - Link document with ID 701

request.description:
Get comprehensive 'Need Your Attention' data for the **logged-in user** including all entities in detail with attention indicators.

**🔐 Authentication & Filtering:**
- This endpoint automatically extracts the user ID from the JWT token
- All data is **filtered by the logged-in user** (userId extracted from token)
- Only assets, components, warranties, AMCs, and related entities assigned to or associated with the logged-in user are returned
- The `loginUserId` and `loginUsername` are extracted from the Authorization token for audit purposes

**This endpoint returns (filtered by logged-in user):**
- **All Master Data:**
  - Users (from asset user links for the logged-in user)
  - Assets (assigned to the logged-in user, with category, subcategory, make, model, status, serial number, purchase date)
  - Components (assigned to the logged-in user)
  - Warranties (for assets assigned to the logged-in user, with asset details, dates, provider, status, terms)
  - AMCs (for assets assigned to the logged-in user, with asset details, dates, status)
  - Makes (related to the logged-in user's assets)
  - Models (related to the logged-in user's assets)
  - Categories (related to the logged-in user's assets)
  - Sub-categories (related to the logged-in user's assets)
  - Vendors (all vendors - not directly filtered)
  - Outlets (all outlets - not directly filtered)
  - Statuses (related to the logged-in user's assets)

- **Summary Counts:**
  - Total counts for all entity types (filtered by logged-in user)

- **Attention Indicators (for logged-in user's assets):**
  - `expiringWarranties`: Warranties expiring within 30 days for the logged-in user's assets
  - `expiringWarrantiesCount`: Count of expiring warranties
  - `expiringAmcs`: AMCs expiring within 30 days for the logged-in user's assets
  - `expiringAmcsCount`: Count of expiring AMCs
  - `assetsWithoutWarranty`: Assets assigned to the logged-in user that don't have a warranty
  - `assetsWithoutWarrantyCount`: Count of assets without warranty
  - `assetsWithoutAmc`: Assets assigned to the logged-in user that don't have an AMC
  - `assetsWithoutAmcCount`: Count of assets without AMC
  - `unassignedAssets`: Assets not assigned to any user (system-wide, not filtered by logged-in user)
  - `unassignedAssetsCount`: Count of unassigned assets

- **Audit Information:**
  - `loginUserId`: User ID extracted from JWT token
  - `loginUsername`: Username extracted from JWT token
  - `filteredForUserId`: The userId used for filtering (same as loginUserId)
  - `requestedAt`: Timestamp of the request
  - `requestType`: "NEED_YOUR_ATTENTION"

**Response Structure:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Need Your Attention data retrieved successfully for logged-in user: john.doe",
  "data": {
    "users": [...],
    "assets": [...],
    "components": [...],
    "warranties": [...],
    "amcs": [...],
    "makes": [...],
    "models": [...],
    "categories": [...],
    "subCategories": [...],
    "vendors": [...],
    "outlets": [...],
    "statuses": [...],
    "summary": {
      "totalUsers": 1,
      "totalAssets": 5,
      "totalComponents": 2,
      "totalWarranties": 3,
      "totalAmcs": 2,
      ...
    },
    "attention": {
      "expiringWarranties": [...],
      "expiringWarrantiesCount": 2,
      "expiringAmcs": [...],
      "expiringAmcsCount": 1,
      "assetsWithoutWarranty": [...],
      "assetsWithoutWarrantyCount": 1,
      "assetsWithoutAmc": [...],
      "assetsWithoutAmcCount": 1,
      "unassignedAssets": [...],
      "unassignedAssetsCount": 12
    },
    "audit": {
      "loginUserId": 123,
      "loginUsername": "john.doe",
      "filteredForUserId": 123,
      "requestedAt": "2024-01-15T10:30:00",
      "requestType": "NEED_YOUR_ATTENTION"
    }
  }
}
```

**Use Cases:**
- Personal dashboard showing only the logged-in user's assets and related entities
- Identifying items that need attention for the logged-in user (expiring warranties, unassigned assets, etc.)
- User-specific data export
- Personal asset management monitoring
- User-specific reporting and analytics

**Note:** If the JWT token does not contain a valid userId, the request will fail with an error message.

request.description: Convenience GET endpoint for scanning. Pass scan value as query parameter. Supports matching by Asset ID, Asset Name UDV, or Serial Number.

Scan QR/barcode with JSON data format. The AI agent automatically extracts structured data from JSON QR codes.

Example JSON in scanValue:
```json
{
  "assetNameUdv": "Laptop-001",
  "serialNumber": "SN123456",
  "categoryName": "Electronics",
  "subCategoryName": "Laptops",
  "makeName": "Dell",
  "modelName": "XPS 15",
  "assetStatus": "ACTIVE",
  "purchaseDate": "2024-01-15"
}
```

The AI agent will automatically:
- Extract all fields from JSON
- Resolve category/subcategory/make/model names to IDs
- Create or update asset with all related entities

Scan QR/barcode with delimited format (pipe-separated). The AI agent automatically extracts data from delimited text.

Format: KEY1-VALUE1|KEY2-VALUE2|KEY3-VALUE3

Supported keys:
- ASSET or ASSETNAME or NAME: Asset name
- SERIAL or SERIALNUMBER or SN: Serial number
- CATEGORY or CATEGORYNAME or CAT: Category name
- SUBCATEGORY or SUBCATEGORYNAME or SUBCAT: Subcategory name
- MAKE or MAKENAME or BRAND: Make/Brand name
- MODEL or MODELNAME or MODELNO: Model name
- STATUS or ASSETSTATUS or STATE: Asset status
- PURCHASE or PURCHASEDATE or PURCHASED: Purchase date

Separators: | (pipe), ; (semicolon), or , (comma)

{

request.description:
Scan QR/barcode with natural language text pattern. The AI agent uses regex patterns to extract structured data from text.

Supported patterns:
- "Serial: ABC123" or "SN: ABC123" or "S/N: ABC123"
- "Category: Electronics" or "Cat: Electronics"
- "Make: Dell" or "Brand: Apple" or "Manufacturer: HP"
- "Model: XPS 15" or "Model No: iPhone 15 Pro"
- "Status: ACTIVE" or "State: INACTIVE"
- "Purchase: 2024-01-01" or "Date: 01/01/2024"

The AI agent intelligently extracts all available information from the text.
